## What is vegetation doing?

3 landscapes, 3 GCMs, ssp245, fire on/off



## Conclusion 1:

- Fire breaks the leagacy lock of existing species composition and allows deciduous vegetation to expand

- In the absence of fire climate alone will not break the legacy lock


## Conclusion 2:

- Fire shapes species composition but also the age distubution.

- Steep increase in pima at the beginning of the simulation may be from fire conditions near the end of the spin-up.



- Legacy locks shape both species composition and stand dynamics


- Plot DBH alongside area dominated


- Climate is warming and wetting but fire not increasing markedly. Climate is controling fire more than vegetation is controling fire.
